description:
Devfolio ke About section ke liye direct markdown template:
🚀 About GlitchFiesta
Welcome to GlitchFiesta, where bugs turn into breakthroughs and problems turn into prototypes.
Driven by our motto, "Code the Chaos," GlitchFiesta brings together ambitious student developers, designers, and innovators under one roof to build real-world solutions in high-intensity sprints. Whether you are hacking your first web app or integrating advanced machine learning pipelines, this is your playground to experiment, fail fast, and build fearlessly.
🔥 Why Participate?
 * Build Meaningful Projects: Go from concept to working prototype with zero boundaries.
 * Network & Collaborate: Connect with top student talent, mentors, and community leads.
 * Prizes & Recognition: Compete for track prizes, sponsor bounties, and exclusive perks.
 * Workshops & Guidance: Get direct feedback on design, code architecture, and pitching.
🛠 Tracks & Themes
GlitchFiesta is open to all domains, with special focus tracks around:
 * AI & Machine Learning
 * Web3 & Blockchain
 * HealthTech & Social Impact
 * FinTech & Open Innovation
👥 Eligibility
 * Open to all college students, developers, and tech enthusiasts.
 * Team Size: 2 to 4 members (Solo hackers can also form teams before hacking kicks off).
Gear up, grab your team, and get ready to turn chaos into code!
